title: Walrus Showcase
tagline: Walrus sites portal running on Fluence decentralized compute
description:
The project is a static site running on walrus sites, using only JS, HTML, CSS but showcasing the capabilities of decentralized hosting.

It is run on an own domain, using a fluence as decentralized compute, and the walrus-sites portal to resolve the url to a walrus site, which is also decentralized.
how_its_made:
An ubuntu image on fluence is running the portal, with an nginx reverse proxy accepting ssl connections. The site itself is published using the site-builder binary. 

There are three distinct use cases: 1. slideshow 2. animated backgrounds 3. product landing page

Visitors can toggle between the three and see how much is possible using simple static tech.
